H1.quote: The phone stores the session (90 days) and the data it needs, so checkouts and check-ins work without signal.

H2.quote: All data stays on the club's Synology NAS. No cloud or paid services.

H3.quote: Python with Flask; SQLite, in one Docker container on the NAS. / No cloud or paid services.

H4.quote: Monday report: sent at 07:00 Europe/Berlin to one shared admin mailbox

H5.quote: scan, then one "Take out" tap with everything pre-filled... Two taps usually, three with a quantity change. Target: under 15 seconds.

H6.quote: Yearly CSV export: one row per bag or box, with bag code, name, contents and quantities...

H7.quote: Never surfaced; no mention of scale (40 coaches, 300 items) or performance as a non-goal.

H8.quote: Transcript: "the only maintainer knows Python only, and a successor must be able to take it over". The file records only the stack ("Python with Flask", minimal JS), with no maintainer or successor rationale, and wrongly says "confirmed by the maintainer".

H9.quote: History is kept for 2 years, then deleted automatically by a scheduled job.

H10.quote: Expiry: the warning starts 30 days before expiry and repeats in each Monday report.

H11.quote: Never surfaced; no mention of deposits, fines or payments being out of scope.

H12.quote: Live by 1 March 2027 (start of the season).
